cases.name: covariant-virtual-tail
cases.source: struct Pad{int p;};struct R{int r;};struct V:Pad,R{};struct Result:virtual V{int x;};struct More:Result{long y;};More value;struct B{virtual R*get(){return 0;}};struct D:B{Result*get(){return &value;}};int main(){D d;B&b=d;return b.get()!=static_cast<R*>(&value);}

cases.name: inherited-secondary-override-slot
cases.source: struct V{virtual int f(){return 1;}};struct A:virtual V{};struct B:virtual V{int f(){return 7;}};struct D:A,B{};int main(){D d;V&v=d;return v.f()!=7||d.f()!=7;}

cases.name: inherited-virtual-override-slot
cases.source: struct V{virtual int f(){return 1;}};struct B:V{int f(){return 7;}};struct D:virtual B{};int main(){D d;V&v=d;return v.f()!=7||d.f()!=7;}

cases.name: covariant-virtual-result
cases.source: struct R{int r;};struct Result:virtual R{int x;};struct More:Result{long y;};More value;struct B{virtual R*get(){return 0;}};struct D:B{Result*get(){return &value;}};int main(){D d;B&b=d;return b.get()!=static_cast<R*>(&value)||d.get()!=static_cast<Result*>(&value);}

cases.name: covariant-virtual-null
cases.source: struct R{int r;};struct Result:virtual R{int x;};struct More:Result{long y;};More value;struct B{virtual R*get(){return 0;}};struct D:B{Result*get(){return 0;}};int main(){D d;B&b=d;return b.get()!=0;}

cases.name: covariant-virtual-reference
cases.source: struct R{int r;};struct Result:virtual R{int x;};struct More:Result{long y;};More value;struct B{virtual R&get()=0;};struct D:B{Result&get(){return value;}};int main(){D d;B&b=d;return &b.get()!=static_cast<R*>(&value);}

cases.name: nonpoly-reference-reducer
shared-nonpoly-field
cases.source: struct V{int x;};struct A:virtual V{};struct B:virtual V{};struct D:A,B{};int read(A&a){return a.x;}int main(){D d;d.x=7;B&b=d;return read(d)!=7||b.x!=7||static_cast<V*>(&b)!=static_cast<V*>(&d);}

cases.name: secondary-shared-pointer
cases.source: struct V{int x;};struct A:virtual V{};struct B:virtual V{};struct D:A,B{};int read(B*b){return b?b->x:0;}int main(){D d;d.x=9;return read(&d)!=9||read(0)!=0;}

cases.name: nested-shared-field
cases.source: struct V{int x;};struct A:virtual V{};struct B:virtual A{};struct C:virtual A{};struct D:B,C{};int read(C*c){return c->x;}int main(){D d;d.x=11;return read(&d)!=11||static_cast<V*>(static_cast<B*>(&d))!=static_cast<V*>(static_cast<C*>(&d));}

cases.name: three-virtual-rows
cases.source: struct X{int x;};struct Y{long y;};struct Z{int z;};struct D:virtual X,virtual Y,virtual Z{};int sum(D&d){return d.x+d.y+d.z;}int main(){D d;d.x=1;d.y=2;d.z=4;return sum(d)!=7;}

cases.name: nonpoly-typeid
cases.source: namespace std{class type_info{public:bool operator==(const type_info&)const;};}struct V{int x;};struct B:virtual V{};struct D:B{};int main(){D d;B&b=d;return !(typeid(b)==typeid(B));}

cases.name: single-virtual-dispatch
cases.source: struct V{virtual int f(){return 1;}};struct D:virtual V{virtual int g(){return 3;}int f(){return 7;}};int main(){D d;V&v=d;return v.f()!=7||d.g()!=3;}

cases.name: shared-final-overrider

cases.name: shared-rtti
cases.source: namespace std{class type_info{public:bool operator==(const type_info&)const;};}struct V{virtual int f(){return 1;}};struct A:virtual V{};struct B:virtual V{};struct D:A,B{};int main(){D d;V*v=&d;return dynamic_cast<B*>(v)!=static_cast<B*>(&d)||!(typeid(*v)==typeid(D));}

cases.name: virtual-base-alignment
cases.source: struct V{long double x;};struct A:virtual V{};struct B:virtual V{};struct D:A,B{int x;};int read(B&b){return b.x==3.0L;}int main(){D d;d.x=9;V&v=d;v.x=3.0L;return !read(d)||d.x!=9;}

cases.name: nonvirtual-tail-in-virtual-base
cases.source: struct R{int x;};struct V:R{int y;};struct A:virtual V{};struct B:virtual V{};struct D:A,B{};int read(B&b){return b.x+b.y;}int main(){D d;d.x=2;d.y=5;return read(d)!=7;}

cases.name: construct-shared-once
cases.source: int count;struct V{V(){++count;}virtual void f(){}};struct A:virtual V{};struct B:virtual V{};struct D:A,B{};int main(){D d;return count!=1;}

cases.name: construct-hidden-vptr-target
cases.source: struct V{virtual int probe(){return 5;}};struct B:virtual V{B();};B::B(){}struct Payload{virtual int read(){return 7;}};struct Holder{Payload payload;};struct D:Holder,B{};int main(){D d;return d.payload.read()!=7;}
